newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador electricity prices jump as subsidies cut.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador electricity prices jump as subsidies cut.

text.p: Ecuadoran electricity rates will rise by an average 110 percent starting this January due to the government's decision to phase out subsidies, Ecuador's Electricity Institute said Friday.
Residential users will face increases of 235 percent, commercial users will have to pay 77 percent more, and industry will face a 53 percent increase, the Institute said.
The government hopes to save $6 million by eliminating electricity subsidies, as part of its plan to cut costs and peg the local sucre currency to the dollar from July.
